CONNECTORS
OVERVIEW
Douglas Electrical Components’ hermetic MIL-DTL-38999 connectors are designed for power, signal, and 
networking applications across various industries. Its compact and lightweight design, coupled with  
robust metal housing and various pin counts, offers design flexibility without compromising durability  
in harsh environments.
MOISTURE-TIGHT, HERMETICALLY SEALED  
CONNECTORS IN 4-6 WEEKS

DESIGN OPTIONS INCLUDE:
• Choose connection types from traditionally non-
hermetic 38999 designs
• Integrate wires, cables, flex and rigid circuits, 
and optical fibers
• Customize the mechanical assembly in various 
materials, interfaces, and design features
• Add increased protection with shielding, sleeves, 
and markings
BEYOND THE CATALOG
Douglas Electrical Components specializes in the design and manufacture of customized hermetic 
connector solutions. Our hermetic technology permits the design flexibility to integrate virtually any 
conductor or optical fiber into a plug-and-play assembly. We can customize the electrical and mechanical 
interface to create a Design for Manufacturing (DFM) moisture-tight, hermetic solution for harsh 
environments and challenging applications.

results.question: At 250 V, how does the per-circuit current rating of Molex .062 miniature nylon connectors change between 1-15 circuits and 24-36 circuits?

ground_truth.reference_answer: They are rated for 5 A per circuit with 1-15 circuits and 4 A per circuit with 24 or 36 circuits, at a maximum of 250 V per circuit.

Models with 1-15 circuits are rated for 5 A per circuit.

required_facts.fact: The 24- and 36-circuit models are rated for 4 A per circuit.

The SOSA™ Technical Standards Group and VITA™ collaborate to bring standardization to the defense and space communities with 
a goal of integrating sensors into everything. VNX+™ (VITA™ 90) is an evolution of the existing VITA™ architecture where SWaP-C 
attributes make it a natural fit for weapons, communications and surveillance systems.
The form factor of an entire VNX+™ embedded module can fit within a 5-inch tube. It enables high-performance sensor interfaces to 
be in close proximity to signal processors, computers and radios. VNX+™ modules 
are designed with standard COTS interfaces supported by Samtec and use a 
variety of predefined combinations of high-speed digital (56 Gbps), rugged optical 
and coaxial RF (110 GHz) solutions.

results.question: How do the sea-level operating voltage and coupling method differ between the Amphenol MIL-DTL-26482 and MIL-5015 connector families?

required_facts.fact: MIL-DTL-26482 operates to 1,000 VAC RMS at sea level and uses bayonet coupling.

results.question: Do Amphenol's gold-plated MIL-DTL-38999 PCB tails guarantee zero corrosion throughout the connector's service life?

ground_truth.unanswerable_reason: The Amphenol catalog specifies gold-over-nickel plating and discusses cleaning flux to avoid corrosion, but it makes no zero-corrosion guarantee or lifetime performance claim.

results.response_raw: Non, le document ne dit pas que les PCB tails plaqués or garantissent une corrosion nulle pendant toute la durée de vie du connecteur. Il indique seulement que les queues PCB standard pour les réceptacles MIL-DTL-38999 ont un placage or de .00005 pouces sur nickel, et qu’une version pré-étamée peut être substituée pour faciliter la terminaison [S1].

results.question: Can Harwin Datamate connectors be operated continuously at 1,200 V AC/DC because that value is listed as their maximum voltage?

ground_truth.unanswerable_reason: Harwin distinguishes the 1,200 V maximum from working-voltage ratings of 800 V for connectors and 300 V for cable assemblies; it does not state that continuous operation at the maximum value is safe.

results.response_raw: Non. Le document indique un **maximum voltage** de **1,200V AC/DC**, mais le **working voltage** des connecteurs est de **800V AC/DC**. Donc le fait que 1,200V soit une valeur maximale ne permet pas de conclure qu’ils peuvent être opérés continuellement à cette tension [S1].
